notes.title: UPDATE II: GENERALS
notes.notes:
Friends! 

We are most pleased to finally introduce to you a swelling new feature - Generals! Those are the new type of cards which will totally change the rules of combat!

 Gather the troops that the general can lead, meet tactical requirements to unlock a general's special ability and see your odds of victory risen decisively! But we warn you, your opponent can do the very same thing! 

At this moment, only four general are available, but we will make sure to introduce more of them soon! Try them out and share your impressions on our channel in a [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/9fNsMmx]Discord[/url]! And stay tuned. 

Also, we wanted to express our warmest gratitudes to those brave soldiers who are helping us to polish the game and its newest features. Thank you guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25915672/fdca28da72685ed5329e6b9414334bfed59a50b6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1: Quality of Life
notes.notes:
Comrades!
 
We've been extremely busy over the past few months developing a total overhaul of HocWar. From this moment forward, we will be regularly releasing updates with new content, features, fixes and so on. This is so exciting for us to finally start sharing results of our work! And here comes the first patch of many:

 - Brand new Deck Editor;
 - Descriptions of cards improved; 
 - Vast amount of UX/GUI tweaks and improvements. 

All in all, this update will make the game more fluent and comfortable to play. Give it a try and tell us what do you think! Also, bug reports and honest feedback will be most welcome. We can definitely promise to find a way to reward you for helping us to improve the game further. Please join our Discord and share your feedback [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/9fNsMmx]there[/url]! Stay tuned for more and fight well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25915672/1d10aaceed19326fd38104009ddcb8b68d138bfd.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v.230775
notes.notes:
Friends!

We are glad to inform you about our innovations:


1. We launched a new system for calculating and storing a rating, and a new principle for rating tables.

Now the game has 2 rating tables - rating by month and year.
At the beginning of each month (starting from February 1), all players will be assigned a base rating equal to 1000. At the end of the month, the leaders of the rating (first five) will receive a reward for a successful month of combat, after which a new stage will begin and the rating of all players will again be equal to 1000 etc.
We remind you that raising / lowering the rating for victories in battles takes place according to the Elo system.

At the end of the year, 5 leaders of the annual rating will receive an award, which we will tell about later.

2. Added new conditions for the end of the battle: if a player or an opponent has all his cards destroyed, then he loses.

3. Fixed user data errors when starting the game on different PCs.

4. Player’s personal file now displays correct data.

All changes will take effect when you enter the new version of the game, all data on combat statistics will be reset, the rating will start, and statistics on the month and year will begin.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25915672/c43211b74621948803312f152f91f9fee4dd4801.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v.230673

In the store, the order of buying booster packs has changed. Since the last update in the game there will be only 1 type of booster packs, in which the player is given the opportunity to open 6 cards to choose from 10.

Also rarities of maps are changed (the rarity of cards affects the frequency of their falling out in booster packs):


USSR:

sergeant -> lieutenant
 
Germany:

lieutenant -> major

sergeant -> lieutenant

- “Wespe”
sergeant -> lieutenant

- “Tank pincer movement”
sergeant -> major

Neutrals:

sergeant -> lieutenant

Come into the game familiarize yourself with the innovations! :)

notes.title: Update v.230662
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

In the last update there was a division into two game modes:
 
1. Basic. This is a battle with a random opponent.
 In this mode, for each victory you get resources and promotion by rating.
The system of selection of the enemy will improve over time, taking into account the wishes of the players.

2. Duel.
This combat mode allows you to create game rooms and play with whom you want, or with those who wish to join your fight.
The main difference of the duel is that when creating a fight, you can bet in the in-game currency. After losing you lose this bet, and if you win - the bet will double. For a win with a zero bet, you do not get resources and do not raise the rating.
Now this mode is being tested, and the rates are not yet active, in the future there is an idea to open it only to players with high ratings, or for the in-game currency. Also we ready to listen to the opinion of active players and testers on this, the issue is still under discussion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25915672/0884abf53c31730f87e99fff69c040c0a8b9f696.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v.230623
notes.notes:
Friends!
We did not share news with you for a long time, because most of the work took place in a special version of the game and was visible only to a small number of testers who agreed to help us with the adjustment. Separate them for this thank you!
During this time, many things have changed, rather complicated organizational issues have been resolved, which hampered the work on the game. At some point, it was impossible to play.
BUT! We were able not only to withstand the onslaught of problems, but also continued to work on the game all this time!
Below we have collected all the innovations and improvements that have been made since the publication of the last major update. All this can already be seen in the game!

So:
- Introduced the rating system Elo, the global rating table.
- A collection of cards, in it you can see the current collection of player cards, as well as all possible cards in the game. Later, the card parsing function will be launched.
- Added rarity indicators on the maps. More details about the rarity will be written later in a separate post.
- Tablet-menu: opens after a click 
- Control of disconnect of the opponent: if someone disconnects, then loses.
-Multiple rework of the network mode of the game.
-New type of lighting. When highlighted for attack, the card is highlighted in yellow. If the card can only attack, then orange.  A card that is waiting for a target to be selected for its special opportunity is highlighted in purple.
- In the chat you can write to private messages.
- In the chat  added a window with players online who are in the game.
- New card abilities are introduced, we'll talk about them later.
- Sound effects card on the field.
-Added a description of the abilities of cards. When you right-click a mouse: an enlarged card + window with a detailed description of the abilities that the card uses
- The work of artillery is realized: the card can attack on all left or right side of the field, depending on where it is located, and also on the center. The map attacks without a counterattack. If the artillery card is in the center, it can attack on both sides, i.e. on the whole field. Walk like an ordinary unit.
-Recovery of neutral cards. Neutral cards - cards that can be used in the decks of the USSR and in the decks of Germany. But you can not create a deck of "neutrals" and they do not have their own side. Neutral cards are only auxiliary.

Added cards:
Units:
1) Sturm guards squad
Durability 1. Brotherhood. Rearguard

2) M3 Lee
Rearguard

3) БМ-37
Direct shot. Rearguard

4) Barrier troops
Assault 1. Rearguard

5) Guarding platoon
Rearguard. Brotherhood

6) Engineering team
Durability 1. Rearguard

7) Pz.Kpfw. I Ausf. C
Deployment: Damage enemy headquarters by 5. Manoeuverability

8) 10,5 cm leFH 18
Assault 1. Rearguard

9) Pz.Kpfw. 2 J
Rearguard. Last Breath: Give +1 attack rate to all your units

10) Т-60
Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to nearby units

11) PTOP deployment
Deal 4 famage to chosen Machinery

12) Arrogant Mining
Deal 4 damage to all enemy units on your side of the field

13) Wespe
Deployment: Deal 3 damage on enemy flanks

14) 4,7-cm Pak 36(t)
Deployment: Deal 1 damage on a neutral ine

15) Radio Operator
Brotherhood. Deployment: Deal 3 damage to chosen unit

16) Ф-22
Deployment: Give chosen unit +2 attack rate

17) Cadets
Rearguard. Deployment: Deal 1 damage.

18) Diversion Party
Deployment: Give to chosen unit Vanguard

19) Maintenance Squad
Deployment: Give +3 health to chosen Machinery

20) Sd. Kfz.251/9
Deployment: Deal 3 damage to chosen unit

21) Pz.Bfwg III Ausf К
Deployment: Give chosen unit Manouverability

Operation cards:
1) Flank Strike
Give +3 attack rate to your units on your flanks

2) Barrier
All your units on a neutral line and enemy's side of the field gain +3 health

3) Barrage
3 damage to all units on enemy's front square and neutral line

4) Front without flanks
Deal 5 damage on the enemy's rear squares

5) Target firing
Deal 8 damage to unit on a enemy's front square

6) Raid
Give to chosen unit Vanguard and -3 attack rate

7) Tracers barrage
Give to chosen unit Rearguard and +2/+2

8) Mounted defence
Give to all your Machinery Durability 1

9) Motti tactic
Deal 2 damage to the units on enemy flanks and Block them

10) Junkers ride
Deal 2 damage to all enemy Infantry and 1 to all enemy Machinery

11) Tank pincer movement
Machinery on your flanks get +2/+3 and Manoeuverability

12) Blitzkrieg
All your Machinery on the battlefield gets Vanguard

13) Tank ambush
Give to chosen Machinery "Damage to Infantry +2" and +3 health

14) Order №227
Take from all Infantry 2 health and gave them +2 attack rate

We hope that you will be satisfied with our innovations! Every day we are working on a project, not everything turns out as quickly as we would like, but step by step we will become better and better! Thank you for being with us! And a special thank you to those who read to the end :-)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25915672/80445d61106441054e9253aa7b4930e0e1e1288c.jpg[/img]
